title: Reverse-Seared Strip Steak with Mushroom Sherry Gravy
description: Trimmed strip steak gets a slow warm-through and a spoon-coating mushroom gravy.

steps.title: Prepare the steak
steps.text: Use two intact {strip} portions about 1½ inches thick; trim exterior fat. Place on a rack over a shallow pan.

steps.title: Warm gently
steps.text: Preheat the Samsung oven on Bake to 225°F. Insert an oven-safe probe from the side. Heat for 20–38 minutes, checking from 15 minutes, until the center reaches 125°F before searing.

steps.title: Build the gravy
steps.text: Soften finely chopped {mush} in {butter} for 5 minutes. Add {beefbroth}, {sherry}, {blackpep}; simmer 3 minutes.

steps.title: Thicken the gravy
steps.text: Whisk {starch} into {cold}. Stir into the simmering gravy for 1 minute until it coats a spoon.

steps.title: Sear and rest
steps.text: Heat {oil} in cast iron over medium-high. Sear both broad faces for 45–75 seconds each. Lower the heat and turn every 30 seconds until each center reaches 145°F. Rest 3 minutes in a warm dish.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Slice thinly across the grain and spoon the warm gravy over the steak.

notes: Make ahead: prepare the sauce a day ahead and refrigerate separately. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze cooked portions with sauce, cooled within 2 hours, for up to 2 months. Fridge reheat: cover and warm gently with a spoonful of water to 165°F. Freezer reheat: thaw overnight in the fridge, then reheat covered to 165°F. The first probe reading is a staging temperature for searing. Use unsalted plant butter for dairy-free gravy. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 297 kcal, 35.7 g protein, 5.8 g total carbohydrate, 13.6 g fat, 0.4 g fiber, 89 mg sodium.
